biggest_catch: $0 annual fee the first year, then $95/year — do the fee math: the $250 bonus is only net-positive if you cancel or downgrade before year two's $95 fee hits, or if the card's categories earn their keep. And $2,000 in 120 days is a high bar — only planned spending counts, never buy extra to fill the gap. Applying triggers a hard credit inquiry, and carrying a balance at ~20%+ APR erases the bonus fast — pay in full every month.
catches: Only pursue spending you already planned to do — never buy extra things just to hit a bonus threshold; overspending to chase a bonus wipes out the bonus math and is how people lose money on it.
